hook: Graphic TSP tours can be found within 89/64 of the lower bound, beating the long-standing 7/5

readout.label: Integrality gap bound, graphic TSP subtour LP

summary: The authors give a polynomial-time algorithm for graphic TSP that returns a tour at most 89/64 times the subtour relaxation value, improving the 7/5 of Sebo and Vygen. They optimize a non-linear objective over an odd-join polytope using a new removable edge system. The gain is small, and the ratio is for graphic instances only, not general TSP.
title: Approximating graphic TSP by b-matchings
